title: What If You Ate Tens of Millions of Bananas? The Radiation Myth
subject: bananas

scenes.text: What if you ate fifty million bananas? Radiation would be your least worry.
Bananas contain potassium-40, a naturally radioactive isotope. One banana is about 0.1 microsieverts.
A chest CT scan, for comparison, equals about 70,000 bananas.
A lethal radiation dose is roughly 3.5 to 5 sieverts, tens of millions of bananas.
But the dose isn't cumulative. Your body regulates potassium and flushes out the extra.
So long before radiation could hurt you, the fiber and calories would.
